review_scope: Black/charcoal with a very faint all-over irregular contour/scroll print, black ring and cuffs. Salmon areas are exclusively branding and omitted. Discrete constant-color contours from branding-free crop [221,410,265,315], 240px sampling, 98 × 116.5 unit reflected repetition; hidden print placement is adapted, and source fabric pixels are not embedded. All palette values are visual estimates. Paint adapts the observed color layout to the unchanged original PNG; no second physical collar is drawn.
limitations: Colors and placement are visual adaptations; original PNG round collar, fabric and folds retained.
